title: In-Person Appointments Fee Waiver Policy
content:
An assessed no-show or late-cancellation fee on an In-Person Appointments visit is waived in full, and the waiver removes the matching charge from the patient's financial account, when one of these grounds holds:

- the patient documents a medical emergency or hospital admission of the patient (or, for a minor, of the patient or of the guardian bringing them) on the scheduled date;
- the clinic was closed or the clinician was unavailable;
- the clinic recorded the appointment in error; or
- the fee was charged although the Medicaid prohibition applied.

**Retired sentences.** Two sentences of this policy are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:

1. *"The patient supplies the emergency documentation no later than the visit type's documentation window counted from the scheduled date of the missed visit."*
2. *"A fee is waived at most once."*

The visit type's documentation window figure remains as published in the fee schedule.

**Counting the documentation window.** The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the scheduled date, and documentation received on the last day still qualifies.

**What is not a ground.** Transportation trouble, forgetting, work conflicts or weather without a clinic closure are not grounds for a waiver. A customer's statement that a document was sent does not replace the document being received.

**No partial waiver.** A partial waiver is never granted: a waiver removes the whole fee.

### Grounds at a glance

| Circumstance | Ground for a waiver |
|---|---|
| Documented medical emergency or hospital admission of the patient on the scheduled date | Yes |
| For a minor, documented emergency or admission of the guardian bringing them, on the scheduled date | Yes |
| Clinic closed, or clinician unavailable | Yes |
| Appointment recorded in error by the clinic | Yes |
| Fee charged although the Medicaid prohibition applied | Yes |
| Transportation trouble, forgetting, a work conflict | No |
| Weather, where the clinic did not close | No |

*Hypothetical window count:* for a visit type whose window is 7 calendar days and a scheduled date of 2026-10-05, the count starts on 2026-10-06, and 2026-10-12 is the last day on which documentation received still qualifies.

superseded_clauses: The patient supplies the emergency documentation no later than the visit type's documentation window counted from the scheduled date of the missed visit.
A fee is waived at most once.
